_comment: The shop's section pages (/figures, /plushies...): their address, heading, Google title and description, and the intro shoppers read. Used by the storefront (src/v3/storefront/landing.ts) and by the build (scripts/generate-seo.mjs). {freeShipping} becomes the store's free-shipping amount. Keep titles under ~60 characters and descriptions under ~155.
